title: Book an open slot
body:
**Story**
As a patient, I want to book one of a clinician's open slots, so that I can see them at a time that suits me.

**Acceptance criteria**
1. Given a clinician's slots, when a patient lists them, then every slot not yet booked is shown.
2. Given an open slot, when a patient books it, then the appointment is confirmed.

title: Never book one slot twice
body:
**Story**
As a clinician, I want each slot booked by one patient at most, so that I never have two patients waiting for one appointment.

**Acceptance criteria**
1. Given a booked slot, when another patient books it, then the booking is refused.
2. Given a booked slot, when another patient tries to book it, then the first patient keeps the appointment.
